behavior: Report reads return a canonical SHA-256 revision bound to report ID, linked student and complete stored content, including legacy reports without write markers.

Save/restore and regeneration require the browser-observed revision after independent ownership checks. Missing, malformed or stale intent stops before history/provider work; the server never substitutes its own read as browser intent.
The existing authenticated atomic content RPC still rejects changes arriving after the server content read. No split-write fallback or provider retry is introduced.
Shared report reader, student report card and restore panel pass observed revisions; same-report revision changes during version loading stop the pending restore.
Link completion reloads report context/revision before subsequent generation; cached readers lacking a revision request a reload.
Demo/sample rendering is unchanged because it has no persistent live save/restore operation; no new role permission or Owner planning interface is added.
